dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans utilizing Department of Veterans Affairs housing loan guaranties and interest rate reduction refinancing loans.
dimensions.evidence: increase the maximum amount of housing loan guaranty entitlement available to certain veterans under the laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Changes the loan guaranty limit from 25 percent to 37.5 percent of the Freddie Mac conforming loan limit and alters refinancing fees.
dimensions.evidence: striking `25 percent of the Freddie Mac conforming loan limit' and inserting `37.5 percent of the Freddie Mac conforming loan limit'.

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts loan fees for refinancing housing loans across specific date ranges up to December 31, 2035.
dimensions.evidence: The loan fee table in section 3729(b)(2) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking the row in subparagraph (E)

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code regarding veterans' housing benefits and fee schedules.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to increase the maximum amount of housing loan guaranty entitlement available to certain veterans

dimensions.assessment: Implements permanent changes to loan entitlements and structured fee adjustments running through December 31, 2035.
dimensions.evidence: (E)(v) Interest rate reduction refinancing loan... (closed on or after December 31, 2035)

importance_detail.rationale: Increases the maximum housing loan guaranty entitlement for certain veterans and adjusts interest rate reduction refinancing loan fees through 2035.
